value_kinds.bool: Read as true when non-zero / written 1 or 0. Any scalar object.
value_kinds.u8: Read or written as an unsigned 8-bit number. Any scalar object (converted).
value_kinds.u32: Read or written as an unsigned 32-bit number. Any scalar object (converted).
value_kinds.i32: Read or written as a signed 32-bit number. Any scalar object (converted).
value_kinds.f32: Read or written as a float. Any scalar object (converted).
value_kinds.scalar: Read in its own type; the block's behaviour depends on it (see the block). B, U8, U32, I32 or F.
value_kinds.gate: Written 1 while active and cleared quietly (0 without marking it updated) otherwise: wire it to enables.
value_kinds.object: A whole object or tree; source and destination must have the same types and counts.
value_kinds.ptr-cell: An element of a PTR object; the block hangs its own tree there.

activation_kinds.enabled: Runs every pass while its enables allow it (always, with no enables); resets or clears its outputs when disabled.
activation_kinds.triggered: Runs when an input it watches is fresh (marked updated this pass) and it is enabled.
activation_kinds.enable-rising: Runs once each time its enables turn it on.

id_kinds.device: The id (u16) of a device created in the project. `contract` names the contract the device must answer, `device_type` the device type that has operations of its own.
id_kinds.pin: An index of an IO resource of the device in the field named by `device_field` (a pin, a channel: the alias says which).
id_kinds.channel: The channel (pin or channel) an event carries, of the device in `device_field`, as that device declares it.
id_kinds.event: The event of the device in `device_field`: the device's own events, or any event when no device is chosen.
id_kinds.action: A record ID (u32) of the action store (SYS_ACTIONS.MD).

op_kinds.change: A setting: sent on the first enabled pass and whenever an argument changed (write-on-change).
op_kinds.edge: An action (toggle, brake, reset): sent once per rising edge of the enable.
op_kinds.read: A reading: asked on every enabled pass, the values written to the outputs in order.

field_roles.device: The device the block works on (an id field with a contract or device type).
field_roles.op: The operation the block performs: one of `ops`; it decides the pins.
field_roles.idle-op: The operation sent once when the block is not enabled (0 = none): one of `ops` that is not a reading.
field_roles.const: The constant of input `i` of the chosen operation, used while that input is unwired (`i` = the field's array index).
field_roles.idle-const: The constants of the idle operation's inputs after its address inputs.

common_rules.rule: The pin counts, the required pins and the size of the private state match the block's palette entry.
